caption: The drawing depicts a metallic wall sconce mounted on a rectangular plate with four symmetrically arranged flared extensions: one each on the top and bottom, and one on each side. Each extension and the main plate have rivets arranged along their edges, and additional rivets are arranged in decorative circular and radial patterns in the central area of the plate. The metal surface of the sconce and plate is rendered as a light gray tone, with shading to suggest a hammered or brushed finish. The candle holder protrudes from the bottom center of the plate and includes a short cylindrical socket for a candle above a wavy-edged round drip plate. The overall design is symmetrical, and the background is plain off-white with the artist's signature "E. L. WAELEY" in small red letters near the lower right side. There are no other objects or color variations present in the image.
title: Candleholder (Candelero) Cut Tin
